sections.Overview: Launch the ball and enter the world of The Jesus.
sections.Introduction: The Big Lebowski Jesus Edition takes Dutch Pinball’s modern classic and gives it a bold new identity inspired by one of the movie’s most unforgettable characters. Featuring exclusive cabinet, backglass and playfield artwork, unique plastics, new details throughout the game and additional software content, the Jesus Edition brings a fresh look and feel while keeping everything that made the original TBL special. Special details include a new bowling alley front panel, a colored Jesus bowling ball launcher, an illuminated Starry apron, premium finishes and Anti-Reflective glass. Production is strictly limited to just 300 individually numbered machines worldwide, making each Jesus Edition a unique piece of Dutch Pinball history.
sections.Key Features:
- Brunswick™ Bowling Alley with 10 controlled pins
- More than 250 quotes and clips from the movie
- Limited to 300 numbered machines worldwide
- Exclusive Jesus Edition playfield artwork and plastics
- Illuminated Jesus bowling ball launch button
- Illuminated Starry Lit Jesus Edition apron
- New software features and gameplay enhancements
- Individually numbered Certificate of Authenticity

TBL v1.15 (Latest - Delta Update) zip 80 MB
- 01 Download the .zip file of the update (without renaming or extracting).
- 02 Copy the .zip file to the root of a USB stick (not in a subfolder).
- 03 Start your pinball machine and insert the USB stick in one of the USB ports of the computer in the backbox.
- 04 Enter the Service Menu and go to "Software Menu" → "USB Update".
- 05 Select the new version from the list. If not visible, reseat the USB stick.
- 06 Wait for "Preparing delta update", "Copying" and "Installing" to finish. Do not turn off the machine!
- 07 Select the new version and confirm by pressing the Volume + button.
- 08 The game will restart using the new version.
When you install an update, the previous version stays available so you can switch back.
All profiles, settings, highscores, and trophies carry over when updating.
